name: New 52-Week High: Forward Return Analysis
description: Analyzes forward 5d, 21d, and 63d returns after equities make new 52-week closing highs. Uses 252-day rolling max on close price to detect new highs. Covers AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, NVDA, META. Outputs: median forward return bars by horizon, 21d return distribution boxplot, event markers at each new high, and summary statistics table.
source:
# New 52-Week High: Forward Return Analysis
# Detects when close price equals 252-day rolling max (new 52-week high)
# Measures forward 5d, 21d, 63d returns after each event
# Universe: AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, NVDA, META

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
ts = index()

# --- 52-Week High Detection ---
# highestbars returns 0 when current bar IS the highest in the lookback
is_new_high = highestbars(period=252)(close) == 0

# --- Forward Returns (look-ahead for research) ---
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_21d = forward_returns(period=21)(close)
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# --- Filter: forward returns only on new-high days ---
fwd_5d_at_high = where(is_new_high, fwd_5d)
fwd_21d_at_high = where(is_new_high, fwd_21d)
fwd_63d_at_high = where(is_new_high, fwd_63d)

# --- Event count (for summary) ---
event_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(is_new_high) and is_new_high) else 0.0
event_count = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(event_flag)

# --- Hit rates: 1 if positive, 0 if not (ternary for correct hit rate) ---
hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_5d_at_high) and fwd_5d_at_high > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(fwd_5d_at_high) else fwd_5d_at_high
hit_21d = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_21d_at_high) and fwd_21d_at_high > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(fwd_21d_at_high) else fwd_21d_at_high
hit_63d = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d_at_high) and fwd_63d_at_high > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(fwd_63d_at_high) else fwd_63d_at_high

# --- Output 1: Punchline — Median forward returns by horizon ---
# Uses series mode: each column becomes a bar
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Do New Highs Lead to More Gains?',
    category='New 52-Week High Analysis',
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+21d', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+63d', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(fwd_5d_at_high, fwd_21d_at_high, fwd_63d_at_high))

# --- Output 2: Distribution — Boxplot of 21d forward returns ---
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.variadic,
    title='How Reliable Is the 1-Month Return?',
    category='New 52-Week High Analysis',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    series_names=['5d Fwd Return', '21d Fwd Return', '63d Fwd Return'],
    order=2
)(values=(fwd_5d_at_high, fwd_21d_at_high, fwd_63d_at_high))

# --- Output 3: Event markers for each new 52-week high ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='New 52-Week High',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='+21d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='+5d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='+63d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(close, fwd_21d, fwd_5d, fwd_63d, is_new_high)

# --- Output 4: Summary table — key stats per horizon ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='New 52-Week High: Forward Return Stats',
        row_size=5, col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Event Count', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% Positive)', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        col_headers=['+5d', '+21d', '+63d'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Event count
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 1: Median return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 2: Hit rate
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 3: Best
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 4: Worst
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='New 52-Week High Analysis',
    order=3
)(
    # 15 inputs mapping to 5 rows × 3 columns
    # Row 0: event count (same for all 3 columns)
    event_count, event_count, event_count,
    # Row 1: forward returns for median
    fwd_5d_at_high, fwd_21d_at_high, fwd_63d_at_high,
    # Row 2: hit flags for mean (= hit rate)
    hit_5d, hit_21d, hit_63d,
    # Row 3: forward returns for max (best)
    fwd_5d_at_high, fwd_21d_at_high, fwd_63d_at_high,
    # Row 4: forward returns for min (worst)
    fwd_5d_at_high, fwd_21d_at_high, fwd_63d_at_high
)
